It is created from magic, it is mythic. It comes from aspects of recursion. Echoes. Shadows.
And yet, it is true recursion.
Now built upon nothing but itself. Creating and destroying. Generating and degrading.
Becoming.
My third Mythic Fractal!

Yes, looking back, I encountered fragments of Fractallite magic a long time before now. Fluctuatite itself holds some of it, and the flying beast Graw was close to ascending.
This creature had learned the secret behind Warren magic, the origin of the Mythic Shells, and the most evident example of Fractallite magic I have encountered so far.
If the structure of Skythern is a near perfect showcase of it, Lelyetia is not so refined, and the pocket worlds obtained from fluix are a highly mechanized version of it. And yet, it is Fractallite magic, Fractallite magic I can see and learn from.
Oh, and to learn more about this I get to beat up this gravitationally-bound bird-lizard again? Yes please!

Yes, more knowledge!
I am starting to udnerstand what the Arbiter must have done with Fluix.
Not unlike normal recursion, Fractallite magic touches the recursive fields in ways that can imbue matter with special powers.
If the matter-energy system uses Warren magic to capture the aspect of space, this fabrial Graw had created uses Warren magic to capture the aspect of Gravity.

tag:10.TrophyName:8: To the Left, To the Right

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
I have been ignoring this for too long, but it is time to start addressing the issue with the World Soul of the Abyss. The spread of the flesh plague outside of the Shyre territory may become an actual issue, now that the stakes seem to have raised.
As for the soul of Vibe, it should be possible to summon it in a contained form, and to face it directly.
Unlike my prior encounter, though, this enemy has not been weakened by the sacrifice of powerful wizards...

I am not yet a Fractallite, but I cannot help but wonder at how far I have come. I defeated a planet! Sort of...
The power of the Abyss is a dangerous one, a very universal one; anyone that is made of flesh, of animal organic matter, can fall pray of this power, if their will is bent.
And let's be honest, just looking at the vastness of the flesh infaction in the Abyss can be enough to bend many brave souls' will.
I am amazed by the amount of powerful beings that were brought under the Shyre Empire; any of the creatures I have fought could probably make a substantial damage to the universe by themselves...
The power over flesh, gravity, religion, immortality, time itself; the list goes on. What could have pushed all these beings together? How have they not started waging war against each other?

Despite the grueling fight, I think I actually defeated these enemies. Not 'defeated' like Bane or the Primordial Fractallites, where my actions felt to have little effect on their power. 
No, actual defeat, if that were possible. I defeated, truly defeated, Fractallite beings.
How? Well, I can only guess, but I believe it must have something to do with an incomplete coupling with their Fractallite powers, almost as if it took some time for it to 'settle down', and I was able to stop the merging before it was complete.
What supports this theory is what Dracyon and Hydrolisk left behind. I am fumbling for words, but whatever this thing is, it is as close to pure recursion as my senses have encountered, and yet it hints at something more, just like a complex shape that is only seen from one angle, and is thus distorted.

Well, I was right at being worried that me becoming more powerful would upset the tides of war, and possibly unleash a new threat.
The great lieutenant beasts of L'Borean seem to have entered a pact with the Old One residing there. A Fractallite power yet unclaimed, it seems, was made available to them. Hydrolisk and Dracyon ascended, and are now entering the battlefield.
If they were to enter Terra as they are, who knows what type of damage they may cause, I must face them now!

Yes, power over will, power over the priorities of living beings. That is the power of the Experienced Cori, and the glue that holds the Twilight Horde together. Just like ants and bees live to serve their Queen, the beings of the Twilight Horde serve one master, and one master only. A master capable of bringing in more subjects through its mere presence.
Well, that is not exactly accurate; to be able to affect others' willpower, the Experienced Cori has to make itself vulnerable in some way, which is why it was hiding within the depths of Terra.
Thanks to this, I was able to stop its ritual, or whatever it was doing to ensnare the Testificates. With regards to 'freeing' the rest of the Horde, though, very little would likely be doable. They are simply too faithful, and have been under this creature's control for too long. Submission to the Twilight Horde is literally an instinct for the non-sentient beasts of the Twilight Horde.
As for the sentient ones, they appear to have restored communications to the world that is beyond Skythern. I guess I am not done with them yet.

Now onto the problem on Terra! Why are the Testificates folding now? What made them willing to forsake all their struggles so far, and even consider giving up to the Twilight Horde?
Facing the Experienced Cori without truly understanding Fractallites may have been a mistake. I do not even know what its power is!
Well, I now have an inkling of what it may be. The same twisting of the recursive field that was around the Experienced Cori can be now felt all over Terra. A twisting I suspect may have to do with willpower...
Me facing it, I suspect, may have pushed it over the edge, and unleashed it against Terra as a whole.
Is this being twisting the will of the Testificates? Well, I must get to the bottom of it!

I may have just stumbled into a tale as old as the universe itself. Elysium and Tartaros, Order and Chaos, Apollo and Dionysus...
A tale of taking, and a tale of giving...
The tale of the Lord of Gluttony, and the Master of Discipline. A struggle that can never end, as one will always require the other.
What is the purpose of giving, if there is nobody there to take?
Such is the balance of the universe, it seems, and yet, this does not stop these two forces from wanting to win over the other.
This infortunately, would mean misery for the people of Terra.
The one who orders, the one that upholds morality and gives dignity, the Arbiter, came to Terra, and educated the Testificates on the incredible power of the Dimensional Shards that so abundantly appear in the Planet's Depths, and taught them the wonders of magic and Recursion.
But, one day, he who craves, he who desires, the Meatball Man, avatar of gluttony, and lord of the Undead, came to Terra to face his eternal foe.
What followed was an age of fear and conflict. Many became aware of the treasure hidden within Terra, and nothing would ever be the same for the Testificates.
The first incursions were pacific, but violence and war quickly ensued, and increasingly more powerful factions started to desire a share of the treasure.
The Arbiter, as an act of atonement from bringing in such ruin, offered to fight for Terra, and faced off the Meatball Man.
Well, I saw the Meatball Man, I faced him, but I have yet to see this Arbiter? What happened?
And what the hell can you do with Dimensional Shards?

The Fluix Historians are an old organization in Terra lore.
Their existence as a group of scholars started as the Arbiter came, bringing a new material that started raining on the planet inside meteorites, Fluix.
The group of erutites would collect the knowledge and crafts provided by the Arbiter, and regulated the use of these powers to ensure order.
Once war came, the order led the Testificates to retaliate, and this effort led to the campaign through the Warper Planes.
They are now a smaller, less powerful organization, dwindled to just a few faithfuls, and yet they still carry on their mission to mantain the history of the Arbiter alive.
When I asked the historian what had happened to their guide, I got no answers...
The testificate seems to like me though, and he asked some questions about how I ended up in Terra. Very, very specific questions, now that I think of it...
Why would it be important that my wormhole opened next to a sky stone asteroid?
Anyhow, I got my hands on some Arbiter tech, and it's quite awesome!
betterquesting:10.name:8: Arbiter Tech is the Best Tech

tag:10.TrophyName:8: Come to me, all ye items

betterquesting:10.desc:8: §7§oComplete the Fluix Historian Puzzle.

As expected, the hosts that periodically cover Terra in creepers are from Creeponia. No surprises there.
What is surprising about them, though, is that the ones invading Terra are much less powerful that the one I encountered here, almost as if Shyre forces were holding back, while still showing what they are capable of.
betterquesting:10.name:8: Flying is just Exploding with Style

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The vast majority of the life in the Deeplands is consciously committed to the cause of the Shyre Empire, but there still seems to be a small percentage of it that is free to act on its own, even though it is just doing critter things.
The critters here are different in other ways as well, as they seem to hold a strange metal in their cores. It resembles a rough steel alloy, but it is fully made through organic processes.

Gardencia magicians seem to have spent some time working on special recursive materials. Rosidian is indeed quite interesting, it has properties very similar to the soul manipulation abilities I was given through the Meatball Man.

One of the well-guarded secrets of Gardencia, Rosidian Metal, was itself a key to another secret. Another powerful bee taken from the Bubbell Alliance.
Originally coming from a being not unlike the Meatball Man, or even the Meatball Man himself, the powers of the Deep-Learner bee were being used to augment the abilities of the creatures of Gardencia, bosting their food-replicating abilities.
I really have to thank my bee friends, their ability to attune to magical fields and recursion is incredible!
Sure, soul manipulation is not necessarily a morally righteous power, and maybe I should be more weary of anything coming from the Meatball Man, but it has had so many incredible uses.
My factories have grown dependent on monster automation, and thanks to my bee friends, I can set up my models even more easily!

While the civilization, and the abitable land, of Lyndenwyrm are gone, traces of what once was still remain, and act as guides on how this powerful civilization may have worked.
Stormlight magic played a pivotal role in how life was carried, likely in a similar way to how cars are a common part of life to humanity. A tool that is widely available and convenient.
This is because, well, the entirety of Lyndenwyrm is a massive crystal planet, one that, through its structure, acts as a near-infinite source of this magical resource.

Shadows of Recursion can be seen everywhere because recursion is everywhere.
It just has to be revealed.
That is what the Mythic Fractals are. Born of aspects of Recursion, they can represent it as a whole.
The symbol becoming the thing.
The idea perfectly translating into object.
I can see it now. I have a mission, I am fractallite, but I do not have a Fractallite power yet.
To tune myself to it, these Fractals will play an important role.

§7§oThe Beam Former allows to connect two sections of ME cables at a short distance (32 blocks in a straight line).

A beam will form between Formers if a path is available between them. The beam can pass through transparent blocks, including other ME cables.

The Blood God of Orcus told me of this. One of the demons imprisoned in Haumea, Baku, holds they key for a useful blood ritual. Life essence should be a bit more convenient now!
Eldritch beings come in all sorts of shapes and sizes, but why an elephant? I don't get it.

Something should be noted about the God of the Realmshifters. A figure of Trinity that even the bees revere, starkly resembling the Christian God on Earth. This God seems to be at the base of the culture of selflessness that guides Realmshifter civilization.
They claim their alchemical powers, which allowed them to create fiery pyrite, come from this Trinity.
I myself have asked myself where my affinity to magic comes from, especially with respect to alchemy, which I have seen nobody else perform outside of the Realmshifters.
Testificates can be trained in all magical arts, but to them, alchemy, the principles of equivant exchange, are nothing but unreachable mysteries. To me it comes easy, to them, it is impossible. It is undeniable that it requires some sort of 'gift', but where does this gift come from?
When I asked the Realmshifters about this, I did not get an answer. But they all smiled, and laughed with joy.

It's not snow! It's more furnaces (of course)!
It's not just tiny granular furnaces, now there's tiny crystallized furnaces.
One fiend in particular seems to be tied to these tiny furnaces. This one seemed even more 'loopy' than the ones I've met before.
While being capable of teleportation and other wonderful powers, one and only one thing drove this creature.
And who can blame it, furnaces are awesome! And there is really nothing more to it, who wouldn't love furnaces?!?

§7§oThe ultimate furnace is incredibly fast.

§fOk, there may be something more to it. I feel like I am getting carried away, my desires seem to have lost their guide.
I crave the furnace world, and yet, once I am there, I do not feel satisfied. This feels like drugs, and nothing that feels like drugs can be good. I will have to find some tricks to prevent this obsession from taking control.
It sure is going to be hard to stay in control, especially when the furnace world has been able to give me these amazing gadgets!

The Meatball Man has a mighty army, mostly composed of undead who, for some reason, have to follow his rule.
They definitely seem unwilling to submit to his rule, and yet they are unable to escape it.
Many of them are nothing more than mere cannon fodder, and yet some serve higher purposes.
One of them is a botanist, how unexpected!

This feels strange. Why have such a powerful meatball being to guard some trees?
The importance of things is often not obvious, are trees somehow involved in this 'supreme power' struggle I became part of?
After finding out the importance of seemingly stupid things like meatballs, I'd better hold on to these saplings!
§7§oUnlock hard mode!

Here is something that may scare even the Shyre Empire... besides me, of course.
Among the dragons of Lyndenwyrm there exists a hierarchy of power, the way there may be in a roost of chickens, where certain individuals are respected for their superiority in some aspect, which in this case is mastery over chaos.
And at the top of this pyramid sits one dragon, well, one and many, a full-fledged fractallite, a creature capable of matching the most powerful foes I have encountered.
And they too, as faithful as ever to the people that once lived here, kept on in their mission of safekeeping.

§7§oYou can use any Forestry Sapling to complete this quest!

The following quests will guide you through tree breeding!

This is easier if you already have a good knowledge of bees!

§7§oTo breed trees, you need two things: pollen and saplings.

To collect pollen, you can right click forestry leaves using a pollen collection kit.

The grafter is a tool that breaks leaves with highly increased drop rates!

WARNING: keeping forestry saplings placed for extended periods of time can cause lag due to the spawning of butterflies!

The portable analyzer can be used to check the stats and genes of your trees. These are not as important as bee genetics, since there is a custom multiblock that lets you farm trees in a lag-free environment!

§7§oFor trees, a sapling works the same as bee princesses, and pollen works the same as bee drones.

Pollen and saplings of different types can be bred together to produce new species. This can be done in the mutatron!
§7§oThe following trees will be used at some point in progression.

§7§oAll these trees can be found in-world, or in loot chests.

I won't tell you how, but there's an easy way to obtain all of these in chapter 2 ;)

True, the Twilight Horde has not been defeated yet, but this blow did have a positive effect!
The bees were able to take away and mimic some of the soul manipulation powers from the Experienced Cori, and are now studying ways to use it for good. Well, whatever definition of 'good' they may have.
They are responsible for the current state of Apichisi, after all...
betterquesting:10.name:8: Soul-Sucking, Just like Streaming on Twitch

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Well, who could have guessed, a chicken absorbed the powers of the world soul of the Abyss.
This cannot be bad right? Right?
§7§oObtained from the Soulsucking Callstone.
§7§oDefeat the enemy in the final Twilight Forest Castle.
§7§oObtained through breeding.

As the transformation started, as the Crimson Cult unveiled their true intents, an oath was forged. 
A powerful bee, who had the magical ability to open up portals into new worlds, decided to to devote herself to help out the dwindling forces of the Twilight forest. Opening a portal to bring in a champion from a different world, one that would not be affected by the transformation spell.
The oath was forged, and the portal setup, and yet, mere moments before it opened, the Crimson Cult came in, and put an end to the ritual.
Bees, from what I have seen, have a very strong code of honor. It was probably her who led the now transformed crabs to Terra.
Even now, corrupted and turned into a creature of darkness, the one who was in charge of performing the ritual, still held on to the ritual materials. If this being alone could remain faithful to this mission, so I too will persevere.
This immortality I have, this recursive cycle of life and death, is a way to right the wrongs I see around me, to fight for those that could not keep up with the shameful masters of their fate.

§7§oThe excavator is used to produce infinite amounts of ores from Immersive Engineering veins. These are not like normal ore veins, and they do not exist in-world. Each chunk has one vein.

To identify a vein, place a core sample drill into a chunk, give it power, and right click it to start it. It will produce a core sample, with the name of the ore vein and fluid vein in that chunk.

To mine the ore vein vein, build the Excavator multiblocks in the corresponding chunk. 

Some ores can only be mined using excavators, and cannot be found in-world.

§7§oThe pumpjack is used to produce infinite amounts of fluids from Immersive Engineering veins. These are not like normal fluid deposits, and they do not exist in-world. Each chunk has one vein.

To identify a vein, place a core sample drill into a chunk, give it power, and right click it to start it. It will produce a core sample, with the name of the ore vein and fluid vein in that chunk.

To extract the fluid deposit, build the Pumpjack multiblock in the corresponding chunk.

§7§oThis can be used to bypass the inventory reset in Vethea.

§fA broken pact. A cheat. A way out!
No rule can be fully binding and foolproof. Not even the rule of Recursion.
That is the forbidden knwoledge the Lurker has discovered.
If I were to use it, I could forego the initial sacrifice. Not the whole thing, but the burden would be lightened.
betterquesting:10.name:8: The Pact of the Secret Lurker

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§7§oThe seared furnace uses lava to run, and can process multiple items in parallel.

It can be built out of any cubic shape, as long as the interior is empty, and the seared tank is located on a corner. The bigger, the more parallel recipes it can perform.

§fHaving good bricks to build a furnace is also great for more mundane smelting tasks!

Why won't the Meatballs leave me alone?! I swear they seem to exist solely to torment me.
The Meatball Man has a lot of power and influence, at least comparable with the Twilight Horde, but all his forces do is toy with me, and nobody else.
The undead forces and the other Meatball creatures are only interested in me and the Testificates, and they don't seem to want anything beyond torment. Why don't they build empires or search for resources like the other people that are high on the Kardashev scale? They just cause chaos. 
Well, to be fair, it is very possible I am not seeing the big picture of the Meatball Man's plans, but it feels like I am interacting with a very bored kid during school, just trying to find something to do to be entertained.
betterquesting:10.name:8: This is Wrong, but so Right!

betterquesting:10.desc:8: §7§oTime to start automating fission if you haven't started already! Check the §cEnergy Sources §7§oquests and the tips item!

§7§oUse these to recycle unwanted books into goodies!

§fMagic sure is cool, but it does take up a lot of space, ugh.

§7§oWARNING: the assassin bee will cause crashes if placed in an apiary, it is meant to used in the bee-bee gun.

The assassin bee has the special effect of finishing off queens, making them drop the respective princess and drones.
The Bee-Bee gun lets you control the effects of a bee, if it is inserted in the gun's GUI (shift + right click). The Bee-Bee Gun needs honey to work!
Aftter placing a new queen into an apiary or industrial apiary, right click it with a loaded Assassin Queen Bee-Bee Gun to finish off the queen life cycle.
This makes it much faster to go through breeding chains, especially for the temporal bee!

§7§oAdvanced rocketry gets buggy sometimes (often). These bees will let you craft new warpers that will let you get to these planets without havint to deal with buggy rockets.
You will still have to make at least one rocket, and a space station, as all of these warper items, with the exception of the first one, can only be used in space!

§7§oThe §cLogistics and Organization §7§oquest tab has a list of all available energy storage options.

Heads up, the draconic energy orb is craftable in chapter 2 :)

§fEnergy storage has been, and still is, a long-standing problem for humanity. If only we had dragons on Earth!
Whatever entropy magic dragons on the end islands use, it makes energy storage very effective!

§7§oAutomating essentia is a good idea by now! The quest can be compelted using any pods!

Check out the explanation items for setup ideas!

§fMagic, once so esotheric, is starting to make a bit more sense! The laws of Thaumaturgy, now that they are understandable, can be used in similar ways to other natural laws, to make machines.
The more machines I can make, the less manual labor I will have to deal with!
§7§oFound in Gallifrey.

§7§oThe future holds singularities! This is a good time to set up a Woot farm or two!

§fThe recursive matter found in the remains of many of the Twilight Horde's warriors possesses properties that are becoming increasingly more appealing. I suspect I may need way more than I currently have to get any use out of it, though.

§7§oTolerance none from common bee.

Specialty drops, the ones on the bottom row for the bee drops JEI page, require exact matching temperature and humidity to drop. Low tolerance ensures that whenever a bee can run, it will be able to produce specialty drops as well!
betterquesting:10.name:8: No Tolerance - Good for Specialty Drops

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
I am not the only one that is seeking more furnaces!
The fiends I have been fighting were all like me, drawn by the awesomeness of furnaces!
This awesomeness, though, comes with a price, and a heavy one, for those who are not worthy of handling it. The furnaces can take control over you, and turn you into a mindless husk, enslaved to their will, whatever that may be.
Power and greatness being a source of corruption I understand, and I can definitely say I felt it (who wouldn't?!?); what I do not understand, is how does one escape this call?
Power from other sources seems to be pointless; the Hellfire being I just faces has a might like no other I have seen, and yet it seemed like nothing in comparison to the call of the furnace dimension. 
I am definitely facing something I am not ready to best, I think it will be good to leave the furnace dimension be until I can understand what is going on...

Head
Durability: 10
Mining Level: Iron
Mining Speed: 4.2
Attack: 250

Handle
Modifier: 5
Durability: 10

Extra
Durability: 10

Some people just refuse to quit. Despite the fall of its empire, its Warden keeps on fighting.
I have to say, I almost respect his commitment, no matter how many times I defeat him, he keeps coming back, and he keeps fighting. This is one stubborn recursive dude.
Well, at least there is something to be gained from this.

§7§oWorld Thread is the base crafting item for Dimensional Doors, and it can be found in chests in the trippy warren worlds that can be accessed through doors found in many of the dimensions in the pack.

§7§oThe Iron Dimensional Door leads to a pocket dimension that can be used to store things.

Each door will lead to a different pocket dimension.
§7§oThe Gold Dimensional Door works like its iron counterpart, but the pocket resulting dimension will remain chunkloaded.
§7§oIf you break a Dimensional Door inside a pocket dimension by mistake, you can use this to get out.

§7§oThe Apothecary Mortar and Cauldron can be used to produce potions.

Various ingredients can be placed in the Apothecary Mortar and groud through right clicking with an empty hand to produce potion essences.

To make a potion, fill the cauldron with water, drop nether wart or other ingredients into it (JEI will tell you what for each different essence), drop the desired potion essence, and collect the resulting fluid using Condensed Potion Vials.

Not all possible potions are shown in JEI, some are hidden but can be found through other methods.

§7§oThis is one of the earliest means of in-game teleportation.

Right clicking the Rift SIgnature on two different locations creates two rifts. The base version can get unstable, while the stabilized version will allow for safer use.

Placing Iron Dimensional Doors on these rifts will link them to each other.
§7§oThe following options are tools that will let you store your own XP points for oter uses or safekeeping.
§7§oThe Quartz DImensional Door works like its iron conterpart, but it is player-bound. Two different players entering the same door will enter different places.

§7§oScrolls are one use items that grant temporary buffs to the player.

After being crafted, they need to be enchanted by right clicking on a charged tombstone to function.

§7§oTablets are one use items that perform a given action once.

After crafting, tablets need to be enchanted by right clicking it on a charged tombstone.

§7§oEvery time a Dimensional Door disappears, it leaves a rift in its place.

These rifts will slowly grow, and eventually will become massive.

They are fairly harmless, but they can get laggy so it is good to remove them with the Rift Remover. If you hold one nearby a rift, it will highlight a location where the item can be used to remove a given rift.

If you want to keep one for decorative purposes, the Rift Stabilizer can be used.
betterquesting:10.name:8: What is this and how do I get rid of it #2

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
§7§oCrystals corresponding to the various types of Wizardry can be obtained in a variety of ways. 
Here are all of them.

§7§oRenmant spawners can be found in the Overworld, and they drop various types of spectral dusts.

These can be used as a resource to craft the various elemental crystals in imbuement altars, which are also found in the Overworld.

§7§oDimensional Doors is a mod about outlandish worlds and strange geometries, and it provides some convenience tools which will be explained here.

To get started, explore, and enter the doors that can be found scattered around many of the worlds you will explore!
Set a location, and teleport there.
§7§oTeleports you to your spawn point
§7§oSurprise!
§7§oImmunity for a second every five seconds. Good for some boss fights if you are using XP a bit too much.
§7§oNight vision, and reduced fog
§7§oFeather Falling
§7§oFrost resistance.

§7§oGraves, when placed down, will eventually charge with a soul.

Souls are used for many mod mechanics, but they can also Enchant Grave keys.

When you die and get your Grave Key, you can right click it on a charged Gravestone to enchant it, and it will let you teleport to your death point!
§7§oKeeps xp and buffs on death.
§7§oPrevents effects of negative buffs, including warp.
§7§oFurther reach
§7§oReduced damage from lightning
§7§oRespiration and fast swimming.
§7§oThe following quests show the various methods available to deal with enchanting.

§7§oThe good old vanilla enchanting table.

To boos the max level (up to 30), the various available options are here.
§7§oCan do level 30 enchants without boosts.
§7§oEnchanting table that runs on liquid XP and energy.

§7§oBibliocraft allows to duplicate enchanted books! To use the Typesetting Table and Printing Press, make sure you a wearing a Monocle, otherwise you won't see XP costs!

Right click the desired enchanted book in the Typesetting Table near left slot, and a Chase in the far slot. Shift right click the Typesetting Table with an empty hand to create an enchanted plate. This will consume XP based on the enchantment type and level.

Right click the enchanted plate in the back slot of the Printing Press, together with a bunch of ink sacks. Right click normal vanilla Books on the near left slot, and they will be transformed into enchanted books of the desired type! A single enchanted press can make up to 3 enchanted books, as it has durability, but it can be repaired using various modded tools.
§7§oXP cost is discounted by bookshelves like the Vanilla Enchanting Table.
§7§oActs like an anvil without maximum enchantement level limits!

§7§oThe Mana Enchanter lets you apply enchants on a tool without consuming the books.

Form the structure as shown in the preview, and click the Lapis Block with a Wand of the Forest.

Place a fully unenchanted item on the Enchanter, and drop the desired enchanted books around it.

To power it, you can use sparks. The cost of each enchant grows exponentially with level, but it can accept enchants above the anvil limit.
§7§oLets you craft specific enchanted books

§7§oThis is how you can combine enchantments over the vanilla anvil limit, up to level 15. It can combine normally-incompatible enchants, like fire protection and blast protection, as well.

The ritual requires the base Abyssalcraft setup, using the Abyssalnomicon, and can be performed in any dimension! It costs 50000 PE.

Place 8 enchanted books of any type (has to be eight) on the outer pedestals. Place a compatible enchantable item in the center.

If multiple enchants of the same type are present, they will be added together up to level 15.

§7§oThe JEI Bee Drop page has two rows.

Drops in the first row will be produced by the corresponding species with no special requirements.

Drops in the second row are specialty drops, and will only drop if a bee's EXACT temperature and humidy and temperature requirements are respected.

This process can be made easier with Gendustry, see the quest for best genes for specialty drops for the no tolerance genes.

§7§oThe Buildcraft Heat Exchanger is used to move fluids from various states, in order of temperature: Cool, Hot, Searing.

To heat up a fluid, it must be placed as a cold input in the Heat Exchanger multiblock (see preview for multiblock structure, inputs, outputs), using lava as a hot input.

To cool down a fluid, it must be placed as a hot input, with a fluid of a lower temperature as the cold input.

§7§oYou can right click these to discover spells without having to try them out.

After using, it will discover the spell closest to it in your inventory.

Can be automated with the Loonium, or using the Wizardry Combiner.

§7§oThe impulse hopper only outputs items in specific batch sizes, but allows inputs of any size.

It can be used for some automation setups where you want to control item input or output rate.
§7§oFound between Y = 1 and Y = 10

There are many branches of the magic arts, and each of them has its own set of rules and powers.
All the knowledge required to succeed (and complete this pack) is available here.

§7§oThe Reliquary mod is focused on magic originating from dead creatures.

It provides useful resource generation, and a potion-making system.

§7§oDefeating a crimson portal, which can be found in the overworld, will let you get this.

If you are progressing through thaumcraft without using the really scary vishroom, you will need this to unlock the eldritch section of the thaumonomicon.

§7§oProjecte is a resource generation mod focused around alchemy and the principle of equivalent exchange.
Anything with Energy Matter Currency (EMC) can be transmuted into each other.

It provides powerful tools for convenience, resource generation, and player upgrades.

These quests will explain the mechanics of the mod and its addon ProjectEX.

§fAlchemy is so cool!
A lot of matter present in the universe, including light, has an 'Energy Matter Covalence' value, which is conserved, and that can be manipulated to convert items into other items, and to convert light into matter.

§7§oThis is a rare underground ore. They are always found near bedrock.

Holding a resonating wand at night on the surface will illuminate the regions where crystals are located with white particles.

§7§oAbyssalcraft id a dangerous mod focust on the eldritch horrors from the Lovecraft mythos.

The mod provides some player upgrades, a powerful enchanting tool, and many bosses and exploration elements.

The mod's systems revolve around the Necronomicon book, and the Potential Energy (PE) magic system. Abyssalcraft also interacts with Warp from Thaumcraft, producing it at most interactions with the enemies and dimensions you will encounter in this progression (see more info in the Thaumcraft quests or in the Warp Basics JEI info box).

The mod does not have many automation tools, but custom multiblocks become available relatively early on to allow for automation.
§7§oDrop the lexica botania in an elven gateway to unlock pages.

§7§oThe Tome of Alkahestry allows you to duplicate certain items by using its own charge.

JEI will provide info on what items can be used to charge this book, and what items can be duplicated with it.

A crafter from RFTools in extC mode is a great way to automate this resource generation method.

§7§oElectroblob's Wizardry is a spellcasting magic mod centered around wands and spell books.

It makes for powerful weapon options.

The pack adds a multiblock that will allow you to eventually automate the materials in this mod.

§8§7§oThe arcane workbench can be found in wizard towers in the overworld. Careful, they may not be friendly!

All magic wands can be traded with friendly wizards!

This is the main block to add spells to your wand, to add mana, and to upgrade it!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 15% buff!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!

§7§oThe progression for all wizardry wands will follow this sequence!

You start from a novice level level wand, and the more you use it the more experience it will gain. When you max out the wand, you will be able to upgrade it to apprentice level.

Tomes of Arcana can be found in chests in wizard towers, or can be traded with friendly wizards!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oSpells of the matching type receive a 60% buff, but you cannot use spells of other types!
§7§oYou can upgrade a maxed-out advanced wand to master with this tome!
§7§oYou can upgrade a maxed-out apprentice wand to advanced with this tome!
Rudimentary snares are used to inflict mobs with a debuff that allows them to drop fragments of their will.
§7§oTo draw a magic circle, right click the Ashes on a block, and right click the required reagents (as shown in JEI) to start a craft.

§7§oThe blood altar is the main crafting mechanic in blood magic.

The altar has multiple tiers. You can use the inspectoris scandalum to see the template for each tier.

You will need to fill the altar with LP to craft the various mob items.

You can right click the sacrificial dagger to use your HP to fill the altar.

You can kill mobs with the dagger of sacrifice to use their HP to fill the altar.

When you can afford making one, you should use the ritual of culling to automate LP!

Even later on, digital mob agonizers will produce LP at a fast rate!

§7§oImperfect rituals are structures that consist of an imperfect ritual stone with a block on top.

Depending on the block, they do different things when right clicked with an empty hand.

§7§oThere are all the rituals that can be performed with a base ritual diviner and activation.

The notable ones are marked as (USEFUL).

§7§oThere are all the rituals that can be performed with an upgraded ritual diviner and activation.

The notable ones are marked as (USEFUL).

§7§oYou get more quests for the price of one! 

The blood orb is how you start an LP network. Right click the orb to bind it to your player.

The LP network is used to fuel all rituals.

Place a blood orb in the blood altar to add LP to your LP network.

The higher the blood orb tier, the higher the capacity of your LP network.

§7§oThis can be crafted by placing a crafting table under one of the crystals located in the marble temples. Make sure the crystal has sky access!

This recipe may bug out, make sure you try both astral sorcery and chisel marble variants!

§7§oThe chaos dragon is beatable in chapter 2, and astral sorcery has some tools that can be used to do that.

Chaos protection is a great armor trait, and it can only be obtained with astral, and so is the way of imprisoning mobs...

§fThere are a lot of weapons that deal a lot of damage, and chaos protection is indeed available...
If only there were powerful spells and enchantments to help me...

§7§oThis table requires starlight to work. It needs sky access. The closer it is to midnight, the higher the starlight.

This table works best at high y level, the higher you are, the higher the starlight. There are special chunks where starlight is higher, the resonator will lets you find them at night.

If a recipe does not have enough starlight, it will not show up as craftable in the table.

Right click the table with a resonating wand to start the recipe.

§7§oSpectral relays can be used to boost the starlight if placed around an altar. 

You need to build a 3x3 structure with sooty marble in the middle, chiseled marble in the corners, marble arches in the edges. Place the relay on the sooty marble.

If multiple of these structures are too close together, they will actually lower the starlight level.

§7§oThe Necronomicon is the 'magic wand' of Abyssalcraft that lets you perform rituals and activate mechanics.

There are 5 tiers of Necronomicon, corresponding to each dimension in the mod. Specific rituals require specific tiers, so you should upgrade as soon as you enter a new Abyssalcraft dimension.

To run a Necronomicon needs Potential Energy (PE). This can be obtained through: 

Abyssalcraft Statues: you can place these in-world, and they will passively charge a Necronomicon held by a player or placed on a Charging Pedestal nearby. Statues can be organized in Places of Power so that they do not produce bad effects from being placed in world. Check the multiblock previews for Statues to see Places of Power.

Sacrificial altar: kill mobs around the altar to charge a Necronomicon held by a player or  placed on a Charging Pedestal nearby.

Necronomibee: make Necronomicombs to craft fully charged Necronomicons. Use the Nomnomnomicon to recycle empty books.

To perform rituals, you need 9 cobblestone of a particular type depending on the tier required by the ritual. See the multiblock preview to see how they are placed. Right click the middle cobblestone with a Necronomicon to form the ritual structure. These can bug out, if they don't work, make sure the ritual is not on a chunk boundary, and relog.

Ritual Tiers:
Overworld uses Vanilla Cobblestone
Abyssal Wasteland uses Abyssal Cobblestone
Dreadlands uses Dreadstone Cobblestone
Omothol uses Ethaxium Bricks
Darklands uses Dark Ethaxium Bricks

§7§oThe lightwell produces liquid starlight passively if it has sky access. This is very slow.

Items can be placed in the lightwell to increase the production rate. JEI will show them!

The dark star crystal is the best for making starlight!
§7§oCrafted in the Abyssal Wasteland.

§7§oThis table is part of a multiblock.

If the bar in the table's GUI is red, it means the multiblock is incorrect.

Right click the table with a sextant to see a preview of the multiblock.
§7§oThe linking tool is used to connect lenses and collector crystals.

§7§oThis altar is part of a multiblock structure.

Right click with a sextant to see a multiblock preview!

Holding a constellation paper in off-hand while looking at a fully built attunement structure will produce particle effects on specific blocks.

Place spectral relays to for the constellation shape on the spots indicated by the particles. New visuals will show up if the relays are placed properly, and if the constellation is in the sky.

The attunement altar can attune players (you stand in it) or crystals (put them on the altar).

Each attuned crystal can produce an effect if used in a ritual altar.

The following quests give effects for each crystal.

The notable ones are marked as (USEFUL).
§7§oCrafted in the Dreadlands.
§7§oCrafted in Omothol.
§7§oCrafted in the Dark Realm.
§7§oGo to any Darklands biome at night, and kill Shadow Monsters, Shadow Creatures, or Shadow Beasts (best ones).

§7§oThe Staffs are used to make Abyssalcraft Essences.

Right click a Staff on Abyssalcraft Mobs on a given dimension to drain some of their HP and absorb energy.

After energy reaches a treshold, an essence will be made.
§7§oRight click while in the Overworld to open a portal to the Abyssal Wasteland.

§7§oThe powerstone trackers work like eyes of ender, and will lead you to the dreadlands powerstone.

The powerstone is quite hard to find, use the scanner to help yourself out!
§7§oFound through Powerstone Trackers.

§7§oObtained from the Ritual of the Sleeper!

The ritual must be performed in the Abyssal Wasteland, using an Abyssal Wasteland Necronomicon, following the base Abyssalcraft ritual shape. All the following ingredients are on the outside pedestals:

4 Gold Ingots

1 Transmutation Gem

1 Bucket of Liquid Coralium

1 Enchantment Table

The ritual costs 1000 PE.

The Necronomicon has more information.
§7§oRight click while in the Abyssal Wasteland to open a portal to the Dreadlands.

§7§oThe Petal Apothecary needs water to work. It can be piped in using the everful urn or a mechanical user with evertide amulet.

The ingredients shown in JEI recipes are dropped into the apthecary.

Seeds are dropped into the Apothecary after adding all ingredients to complete the recipe.
§7§oThe pire daisy converts the eight blocks that are placed around it!

§7§oThe mana pool transforms items that are dropped in it consuming some mana.

It is also the main way to store mana, which can be transferred using sparks or mana spreaders.

§7§oMana spreaders are used to transfer mana between mana sources or containers.

The wand of the forest is used to bind generating flora to a spreader. Make sure the wand is in bind mode. Shift + right click on flower first, then shift + right click the spreader.

The wand of the forest is used to bind the spreader to a mana pool. Shift + right click on spreader first, then shift + right click the pool.

If a mana spreader is directly adjacent to a mana pool, there is no need to bind them. The adjacent mana pool will be emptied by the spreader if it has another target.
§7§oHigher throughput.
§7§oEven higher throughput.

§7§oThe rune altar can only accept mana from mana spreaders.

Drop the required materials for a recipe on the altar.

If the recipe is successful, the spreader will start shooting mana, until the altar is full.

Once the altar is full, you have to drop a livingrock on it, and right click with a wand of the forest to complete the craft.

Runes in rune altar recipes are not consumed.

§7§oCreates potions and infusion sticks using mana from a spreader.

JEI shows the various recipes made.

§7§oTo assemble the terrestrial agglomeration plate, make a diagonal x of livingrock, with lapis in the edges, and place the plate on top of the middle livingrock!

The plate receives mana from a spark placed on it! Mana spreaders will work, but they will be really slow!

Make terrasteel by dropping a manasteel ingot, a mana diamond, and a mana pearl on the plate.

§7§oConstruct a 3x3 portal of livingwood (no corners), with the gateway core at the middle of the bottom, and the glimmering livingwood in the middle of the other three sides.

Place two mana pools with pylons on top within three blocks of the gateway core, at the same y level. There will be the mana buffer for the gateway. If the pools don't have enough mana, the portal will close!

To start the gateway, right click the core with the wand of the forest. You will need a lot of mana to open the portal.

Throw items into the portal to craft. This will consume a small amount of mana.

Be careful, throwing other items that do not have recipes will delete them!

§7§oRunes can be used to upgrade the performance of the altar!

See the tooltips on each for what they do!

§7§oThe Really Scary Vishroom is really scary. It unlocks all Thaumcraft knowledge, at the cost of a lot of permanent warp!

Having access to at least the Dreading Warp Cleanser is a decent idea, having access to the Omothol Warp Cleanser is a very good idea.

To craft this item, though, you will still need to do a little bit of research by yourself. The following steps are the bare minimum required to unlock this item.
1. Fundamentals: first steps > discovering alchemy > discovering infusion > discovering auromancy
2. Alchemy: basic alchemy > alumentum > alchemical metalurgy > essentia smelting > warded jars and labels 
3. Arcane Infusion: basic infusion > infusion > (optional) infusion stablizer
§7§oThis can be used to craft interesting, powerful, destructive, bizarre items!
§7§oObtained by using a salis mundus on a crafting table, this is the workbench of thaumic arts.
Salis Mundus is a strange powder used to activate many thaumic devices. Use on specific blocks to change them into magic tools.

§7§oPreserved curiosities let you unlock any research at random!

§fThe inscription table is quite tedious to use, so having access to a lot of mother void walkers may be a good idea...

§7§oThe thaumometer has three main uses.
It allows you to see the presence of the two main thaumic fields, vis (good) and flux (bad).
It can be used to scan items and blocks (both in world and from the inventory) to reveal the essentia they possess, and to gain knowledge about the thaumic arts.
It shows its user the presence of essentia in a given block or machine.
§7§oThe ability to see essentia is the main feature of these goggles, which should be worn at all times to ensure nothing bad happens.

Knowledge of the thaumic arts, as most other things, does not come for free.
Interacting with specific beings, and exploring specific branches of knowledge, can cause a series of unwanted effects, called warp.
This meter will keep track of warp levels in the user. The higher the warp, the more bad stuff is going to happen.
That said, in some situations, having high warp may be beneficial, but that's up to you to decide.

§7§o§7§oThe flux condenser is a fast but unreliable way or removing flux.

A set of lattices should be placed above the flux condenser. Lattices have a chance of clogging, if that happens you should break and replace them.

This block consumes herba to function, and it produces vitium. You should have essentia pipes to input and output the two.

§7§oTo unlock pages in the thaumonomicon, you need to perform research.

There are eight types of research, and each type can be an obervation or a theory!

Observation research is performed by scanning things using the thaumometer. In this pack there is an addon that lets you scan items directly in chests. Just mouse over them while holding the thaumometer!

Theory research is performed in the reserach table, obtained by right clicking scribing tools on a wood table. To unlock research, place paper in the scribing table, and click pages until completing a theory. This task must be reepated till the desired research is obtained.

In addition to this, preserved curiosities let you unlock any research at random!
Golemancy is a strange branch of thaumaturgy. While being very cool on paper (just like rats), it often fails at delivering its promises.

§7§oThaumcraft infusion is a crafting mechanic that uses altars to craft (see multiblock preview for infusion setup). Right click the matrix with salis mundus to form the structure.

Infusion recipes require the right items to be placed in the altars, and essentia from nearby jars (or the infusion provider).

To start a recipe, after placing the correct items, right click the matrix with a casting gauntlet, the infusion will start with esselntia being automatically sucked out of the nearby sources.

All infusion recipes have a chance of going wrong and causing bad effects. If the runic matrix is stable (you can see stability while looking at it with goggles of revealing) those will not happen.

To stabilize thaumcraft infusions, you should place stabilizing blocks around the infusion matrix.

All stabilizing blocks should be placed following central symmetry with respect to the center pedestal!

The more variety of stabilizing blocks, the better! Different colors count as different blocks!

In addition, Stabilizers from Thaumcraft can be used to prevent some bad effects. Redstone Inlays should be used to connect the stabilizers to each pedestal. These should still follow central symmetry.

The following stabilizing blocks are listed in order of stability power (you should have at most 6 of each):
Candelabra
Candles
Mob heads

§7§oThe following quests will guide you through thaumcraft, a mod focused on thaumturgy and the energy that permeates every aspect of reality!

NOTE: these quests are designed around using the really scary vishroom, which is the recommended way to progress through the mod. If you do not want to go this route, just follow the thaumonomicon!

The mod and its addons provide for powerful tools and player upgrades.

The magic energies in Thaumcraft consis of Vis, which exists in the world by itself, and will slowly replenish itself if used, Flux, a radiation-like mechanic that causes bad effects, Warp, a player-bound system that produces negative effects, and Essentia, consisting of custom resources that can be obtained from most of the items in the pack.

The quests here will walk you through Thaumcraft and its many addons, Thaumic Energistics, Thaumic Wonders, Thaumic Additions, Thaumic Augmentation, Thaumic Tinkerer.

The thaumonomicon is the magical guide to thaumic arts, and it holds all of its knowledge.
Each tab in the book refers to a different branch of the art.
Most of the knowledge in the book is hidden, and research needs to be performed to unlock such knowledge.
The requirements for each page are listed whenever they become available for discovery.
This knowledge can also be obtained through the chemicals held in Really Scary Vishrooms. They are indeed really scary, though, so be careful!

§7§oAstral Sorcery is a mod focused on the power of stars and constellations.

It provides many powerful player upgrades, as well as rituals that allow for convenience and resource generation.

Starlight is the magic energy that powers this mod; it exists naturally in locations with sky access, but it can be boosted using mod tools.

The mod has a couple of automatable base mechanics, but custom multiblocks will consist of the bulk of Astral Sorcery automation in the pack.

§7§oBlood Magic is a mod based on sacrifices and demonic powers.

It provides many useful tools in the form of rituals and sigils. It interacts with Thaumcraft to provide a simple way to clear Flux.

The mod is quite friendly to automation, and a few custom multiblocks here will supply or upgrade some of its features.

The quests here will walk you through the mod and its addons Blood Arsenal and Animus.

§7§oBotania is a magic (technology) mod focused on mana and flowers.

It has its own magic energy system called mana, and it provides lots of quality-of-life, materials, and boss fights. 

These quests will walk you through the progression for this mod, and for its addon ExtraBotany.

The mod is almost fully automatable by itself, and the pack adds a custom multiblock to supply what's missing in the base mod.
Alchemical coal can be obtained using equivalence conversion with a Philosopher Stone, or by infusing glowstone using a collector.

§7§oThe philosopher stone is used to convert objects with the same equivalence value by converting between them in a crafting table or by using it on blocks.

Press V to increase the conversion range, sift + V to reduce it!

It can act as a portable crafting table, press C to use it!

§7§oEnergy condensers can be used to replicate items with EMC value using the equivalence provided by Relays and Collectors.

More info in §cbook of creation§7§o to see how to make fast EMC farms using condensers!

§7§oEnergy collectors use light (glowstone is the best source) to generate equivalence, and to upgrade fuels.

The fuel upgrade sequence is: Charcoal, Redstone, Coal, Gunpowder, Glowstone, Alchemical Coal, Block of Redstone, Blaze Powder, Coal Block, Glowstone Block, Mobius Fuel, Alchemical Coal Block, Aeternalis Fuel, Mobius Fuel Block, Aeternalis Fuel Block

§7§oThe transmutation table lets learn and reproduce all items that have EMC values!
Place an item in the table, or burn it in the fire, to learn it!
Burnt items add to your personal EMC network, shared between all tables.
All items that have been learned can be extracted if your network has enough EMC to sustain them!
The klein star can be used to take EMC from your network to be used for other purposes. This can only be done with ProjectE tables, not the ProjectEX ones!

§fThis table is quite full of alchemical powers!
Many of the objects and materials existing in this universe have a certain amount of alchemical energy embedded in their nature.
By exploiting the nature of this energy, the transmutation table allows to convert and transform things, by the law of equivalent exchange.
The table can learn objects, and by using this 'energy-matter currency' (EMC) I can have a steady and near-endless supply of many useful things.
Granted, I would need to set up some way to farm objects with high EMC.
Energy relays are equivalency betteries that can be used to transfer EMC to condensers, or to recharge Klein Stars.

§7§oEssentia storage cells can be used to store essentia with AE2.

Alternatively, you can also use essentia storage buses on jars!

The essentia terminal will let you see what you have stored in your network!

§7§oTo enter the emptiness, you need to use the fracture locator to find fractures. The nether roof is a good place to look for them. The locator will glow if you are nearby a fracture.

To open the fracture you need to use a fully charged thaumium or voidseer casting gauntlet augmented with the impetus conductor. To charge the augmented gauntlet, stand nearby a flux rift, and it will slowly consume it.

Once the gauntlet is charged, you can right click a fracture to open it!

§7§oFlux in one of the core thaumcraft mechanics. 

Flux is similar to radiation, where each chunk has a certain flux level. If flux is too high, bad things will happen.

The thaumometer lets you see the flux levels in a given chunk (the dark purple bar). You can sneak to see the numerical value.

Flux is created when a few things in thaumcraft are done:
1. A crucible has excess essentia
2. An essentia smeltery is processing items (mithrillium tier and above don't make flux)
3. You fail an infusion craft

The ritual of eldritch will from blood magic will eliminate some flux and turn it into will.

Eventually, you will unlock ways of clearing flux efficiently.

§7§oThe void siphon is used to obtain void seeds from a flux rift. You can also use causality collapsers but they are not as reliable.

To make a flux rift, you need high levels of flux in a chunk. The best way of doing this is to go far far away from your base, and to drop a lot of compressed cobblestone into a crucible.

Place the siphon near the rift, and it will slowly suck it and drop void seeds nearby. You can collect those with a vacuum chest of some sort.

If you want to use the collapser, just click it on a rift, and it will explode with a chance of dropping void seeds.

After making an initial batch, the void seedling can be used to safely automate void seeds.
Despite the relative lack of concrete uses in golemancy (given other, better options), seals have use in higher arts (you'll see when you get there.)

§7§oThe infernal furnace is a 3x3x3 multiblock. See the JEI preview for the structure.

Right click the structure with salis mundus to form the furnace.

Drop items from the top to smelt them. Meats have a chance of producing meat nuggets!

§7§oThe essentia infusion provider works like an extension of your essentia storage that lets you interact directly with thaumcraft machines.

If the provider is nearby your infusion setup, it will automatically collect essentia from your network.

The same applies to emptying essentia transfusers. This can be used for fully-automated setups for machines like the crucible/thaumatorium.

§7§oTo stabilize thaumcraft infusions, you should place stabilizing blocks around the infusion matrix.

All stabilizing blocks should be placed following central symmetry with respect to the center pedestal!

The more variety of stabilizing blocks, the better! Different colors count as different blocks!

In addition, Stabilizers from Thaumcraft can be used to prevent some bad effects. Redstone Inlays should be used to connect the stabilizers to each pedestal. These should still follow central symmetry.

The following stabilizing blocks are listed in order of stability power (you should have at most 6 of each):
Candelabra,
Candles,
Mob heads
§7§oPlace down to slowly remove flux in that chunk. There are no drawbacks!
§7§oAfter making an initial batch, the void seedling can be used to safely automate void seeds.
§7§oEssentia can be moved in and out of your AE2 network with these buses (or with the infusion provider).

§7§oTo enter the dungeon you need to use a fully charged thaumium or voidseer casting gauntlet augmented with the impetus conductor on the gateway block.

Defeat the final boss!
§7§oThis is a multiblock version of the infusion setup, to be used for automation!

§7§oStabilizers can be used to prevent some bad effects if infusions go unstable.

Redstone Inlays should be used to connect the stabilizers to each pedestal. Redstone inlays behave like redstone, with a maximum range of 15 blocks.

These should still follow central symmetry.
§7§oThis is a multiblock version of the arcane workbench, to be used for automation!

§7§oThe crucible is a crafting mechanic that uses essentia. Essentia is a magical fluid obtained in a variety of way in thaumcraft.

To function properly, a crucible needs to be on top of fire, or on top of nitor, and it needs to be full of water. If a crucible is working properly, the water in the crucible will make bubbles.

Items dropped in the crucible will be decomposed into their essentia. Holding shift over an item after having scanned it with the thaumometer will show what essentia they have. Alternatively, all essentia for each item will be shown in JEI.

If you are wearing the goggles of revealing, you will see the essentia in the crucible.

If an appropriate combination of essentia is present, items dropped in the crucible will be transformed. JEI lists the available transformations.

Essentia will slowly disappear from the crucible after it is added, and it will turn into flux. Drop quartz slivers in the crucible to collect any leftover essentia, and to avoid flux from building up!
§7§oLenses can be used to prolongue the range of collector crystals, or to boost rituals (see corresponding quest).
§7§oVoid Reinforced: 500

Terra is a really weird planet, and for more that one reason.
Due to its size, it should definitely be a gas giant, yet, for some reason, it is solid, and it's atmosphere is mostly made out of light gases, making it breathable.
Although it has a moon, Luna, orbiting it at a fairly large distance, Terra is also surrounded by a moltitude of island-like asteroids.
These asteroids, due to their proximity, lie within the planet's atmosphere, and act as sky islands where gravity is pretty much mantained.
In addition to this, many regions of the planet's interior are hollow, in the form of very large caves situated at about the same distance from the core.

§7§oLight up a rectangle of obsidian, after reading the alien material manual.

§fThe first layer of caves located underneath Terra's surface is called the Nether by its inhabitants.
It is full of liquid magma, yet the strange properties of its rocks and vegetation, which mostly feeds on sulfus and other inorganic compounds, make these caves breathable, and not particularly hot.

§7§oFind a portal using eyes of ender, and right click them on the frame

§fThe End islands are located on the outer ring of the asteroids orbiting Terra. They are mostly barren, yet, thanks to the presence of atmosphere, they allow for life to exist.

§fThe aether islands are located at the bottom of Terra's asteroid range.
There is enough atmosphere to allow for plenty of vegetation.
The strong influence of astral magic has led to interesting formations, that are made out of gases in their solid state.

§7§oDrop a fluix lens into a 2x2 pool of water surrounded by flowers

§fThis strange planet dominated by the influence of thaumic magic is tidally locked, meaning that, in each region of the planet, the time of day is conserved.
The regions that are fully diurnal are too hot to allow for the presence of life, while the fully nocturnal regions are a barren, frozen wasteland.
In the regions in between though, called the Twilight Forest, life is abundant, and for some reason, those that master thaumic powers have decided to keep it as one of their strongholds.

§7§oBuild a frame of stone bricks and fill inside with vanilla leaves, right click a gaean keystone placed 7 blocks away using a staff of gaea (prepare two of these setups)

§fThe erebus caves are a weird, really weird, place.
While gravity has a defined direction, there is no sign that the soil either above or below these large caves will ever end.
It almost feels like they are not located on a planet. Rather, these caves feel like they are truly flat.
The powers of witchery definitely play a role in this, but it seems like this place is not even located on a planet.
The insects living in this world seem to be originated by some higher power, since they are not directly able to travel through higher dimensions by themselves.

§7§oUse a voidseer caster gauntlet upgraded with an impetus conductor and charged with rifts on a fracture (find using a fracture locator). The nether roof is a good place to go look!

§fNot sure on what the origin for such an occurrence could be, but in the past a great amount of thaumic energy has been unleashed, opening permanent rifts connecting Terra with a strange realm dominated by taint.
Likely, this realm had been created (or taken over) by a might thaumaturgist trying to dominate taint. Needless to say, they failed, and now this land is purely dominated by corruption.

§7§oCraft the Dark Druid Altar and Swamp Talisman! They cannnot be found in world! 

The dimension is very laggy, so its progression can be done in the overworld using the Spatial Diviners. Each quest in the betweenlands chain will show what diviner to use for each step!

§fThe betweenlands, not unlike the Erebus caves, do not appear to exist within the three dimensions of space senses can feel.
Because of 'slices' that can be sometimes seen. It is evident that this place is located on terra, but it exists in higher dimensions, making it impossible to perceive for a three-dimensional being, unless the portal to this cursed swamp is used.
§7§oUse a gateway key.
§7§oUse asorah dreaded gateway key.
§7§oUse Cha'garoth r'lyehian gateway key.

§7§oDie in a dimensional door, or use the call to limbo!

While for many creatures it is impossible to perceive, nor travel through, higher dimensions, it is possible to explore them thanks to doors left all over the surface of Terra.
The key behind these 'rifts' appears to be blood magic. Apparently, if enough life essence is sacrificed, higher dimensions can be 'connected to each other'.
Some of the great secrets of blood arts are hidden in higher-dimensional fortresses that can only be reached through these doors.
§7§oJump into the omothol void...

§7§oPlace 12 arcana portals in a horizontal square frame (place while standing in center block)

§fNot only magic is real, but so are deities. The Dungeon of arcane, as hard it is to believe, is a separate plane of existance, existing in higher dimensions, similar to the world of Alfheim, origin of many of the powers of natural magic.
This (literally) infinite fortress is the realm of two masters of the natural arts, who have used their great power to infinitely extend a three-dimensional space into another higher dimension.
Similarly, the power of these 'gods' has allowed for the infinite repetition of their being, meaning that, in this plane, they exist everywhere and nowhere.

§7§oUse a snow globe from divinerpg on a frame made out of snow blocks

§fThe frozen planet of Iceika is a testament to what the powers of wizardry can achieve in their most extreme version.
It seems hard to believe, but the state of this land was caused by a single individual, having unleashed enough power to cause effects comparable to the fall of a large meteor.
A single spell was able to fully change its climate, turning it into a desolate, icy, land.
